title: fix(devin): resolve stuck placeholder on Devin CLI session spawn
context:
CCC now matches the spawned Devin CLI session (wrapper vs child pid,
newline-flattened prompts), attaches spawn_pid so the card swaps, shows
the spawn log while it materializes, and only treats a Devin session as
live when the lock file's process is actually running.
 What changed: added _devin_cli_lock_pid, _devin_cli_pid_alive, _devin_cli_raw_id_for_pid, _devin_spawn_pid_by_session_id, isSpawnLogPlaceholderSource, test_devin_prompt_match_ignores_whitespace, test_devin_spawn_session_id_resolved
decision: Changed ccc_server/devin.py, server.py, static/app.js, tests/test_devin_queue.py, tests/test_smoke.py: added _devin_cli_lock_pid, _devin_cli_pid_alive, _devin_cli_raw_id_for_pid, _devin_spawn_pid_by_session_id, isSpawnLogPlaceholderSource, test_devin_prompt_match_ignores_whitespace, test_devin_spawn_session_id_resolved_from_lock_pid, test_devin_cli_session_live_requires_live_pid; changed _devin_cli_session_live, _take_claude_prewarm; new dep(s): ccc_server.devin.
